text: In this month, forty-three of us said "mental health crisis," peaking on 2016-07-06. Forty-two of us said "mental health crisis act" the same day; forty-one said "helping families in mental health crisis" and "families in mental health crisis act." Forty of us said "the helping families in mental health." Two days later, on 2016-07-08, thirty-five of us said "and recovery act," and thirty-four said "comprehensive addiction and recovery act" and "the comprehensive addiction." The bill names carried us. We converged first on the mental health language on the sixth, then on the addiction language on the eighth, moving as two clustered days around two named acts. The record shows we said the same titles in the same window, in these counts.
